facts.text: Villa Le Blanc Gran Melia is in Santo Tomas, Menorca, Spain.
facts.excerpt: Villa Le Blanc Gran Meliá, Menorca - Santo Tomás Spain

facts.text: The hotel's Personal Taste experience lets guests taste typical Menorcan products and discover island workshops.
facts.excerpt: Taste typical Menorcan products accompanied by the best masters, take part in their elaboration, and discover the island’s most emblematic workshops.

facts.text: Guests can choose an oil or saffron tasting that includes a visit to the plantation.
facts.excerpt: Choose between an oil or saffron tasting visiting the plantation

facts.text: Guests can make their own cheese as part of the experience.
Guests can visit a Menorcan wine and vermouth cellar with a tasting included.
facts.excerpt: visit a Menorcan wine and vermouth cellar with an exquisite tasting included

facts.text: Guests can enjoy a tasting of the island's artisan beers.
facts.excerpt: enjoy a tasting of the island's artisan beers

facts.text: The experience includes a tour of Menorca in a Land Rover Defender.
facts.excerpt: Embark on an unforgettable tour of Menorca in a Land Rover Defender

facts.text: These private experiences belong to the hotel's collection called The art of good living.
facts.excerpt: Private and exclusive experiences of Villa Le Blanc Gran Meliá and its collection "The art of good living".

facts.text: The experience takes a maximum of 8 people.
The experience must be booked at least 48 hours in advance, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Book at least 48 hours in advance, subject to availability.

facts.text: The experience includes up to two dining experiences to choose from plus the Land Rover Defender trip.
facts.excerpt: Up to two dining experiences to choose from plus trip in Land Rover Defender.

facts.text: Bookings are made through the hotel reservations team by phone or email.
facts.excerpt: To book or request detailed information, please contact our hotel reservations team by phone or email.
